feet. Opponents within the storm will take continual
damage.

deals extra damage to already drowsy targets. The user’s

move’s type changes depending on the kind of drive held

hearts of its targets as it charmingly dances out of the
way of attacks. This may also make targets drowsy.

damage to targets.

the sky. This move is both Fighting and Flying type

slows the movements of susceptible opposing Pokémon
that make contact with it.

short time, then surfacing to strike targets. This attack
can hit targets using moves such as Protect or Detect.

the Ghost type to targets.

The user attacks by unleashing a wave of electricity.
The user’s HP will be restored by a portion of the damage
dealt.

text:
The user places the curse of the forest on targets. This
adds the Grass type to targets.

it may also leave targets frozen.

The user attacks by letting out a charming cry that causes
emotional damage.

rushing back to its Trainer. This lowers targets’ Attack
and Sp. Atk stats for a short time.

also dealing damage to any attackers that make direct
contact.

lowers targets’ Sp. Atk stats for a while.

from targets and restore the user’s own HP.

internal energy and raining them down upon targets.

the ground. Any Pokémon hit by the wave cannot be
switched out of battle.

The user attacks by gathering energy from the land and
focusing that power on targets.

also take some damage.

high speed. This also lowers the user’s Defense and

itself.

entering a battle.

movement speed for a short time.

move takes some time to carry out.

and Reflect.

loses the ability to switch out of battle.

unable to move for a short time.

user’s movement speed for a while.

this move’s power.

projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and
Sp. Def stats for a short time.
